title: SciInstruct: a Self-Reflective Instruction Annotated Dataset for Training Scientific Language Models
authors_zh: Dan Zhang, Ziniu Hu, Sining Zhoubian, Zhengxiao Du, Kaiyu Yang, Zihan Wang, Yisong Yue, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: 科学推理过程数据构造与过滤研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建跨学科科学 SFT 数据，或审计自我反思教师轨迹的读者。
one_line: SciInstruct turns answer-only science questions into open worked-solution records through staged generation, self-reflection, outcome checking, and learned quality filtering.
SciInstruct 通过分阶段生成、自我反思、结果核验和质量分类，把仅有答案的科学问题转成开放的分步解答记录。
why: It makes the transition from scarce answer-only scientific problems to reusable rationale SFT data explicit and evaluates both mixture components and filtering decisions.
inclusion_reason: SciInstruct centrally releases worked scientific reasoning demonstrations and exposes an answer-filtered, self-reflective trace-construction pipeline whose records are directly consumed by SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
# Problem

College-level science question banks often provide a final answer but no reusable derivation, while producing expert rationales manually is expensive. SciInstruct gathers science, mathematics, and Lean proof problems and converts missing solutions into worked instructions through answer-aware generation, reflection, and quality filtering.

The decision boundary is creation and selection of scientific rationale records, not scientific pretraining or a model-only report: each serialized question, worked response, and subject label is consumed by SFT, with known answers, GPT-4 outcome judgment, and a learned classifier providing feedback.

L4 facts: official NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks proceedings hash 02ee6b7295f720407b56c457b34c54d5; reported scale 254,051 instructions; open CC BY 4.0 data; L4_carded with one Track 01 category.

# 问题

大学层级的科学题库常有最终答案，却没有可复用的推导，而逐题编写专家过程又代价很高。SciInstruct 汇集科学、数学和 Lean 证明问题，通过答案感知生成、反思与质量过滤，为缺少过程的问题补充分步解答。

论文的判断边界是科学推理记录的生成与筛选，而不是科学预训练或只发布模型：序列化的问题、分步回答和学科标签直接进入 SFT，已知答案、GPT-4 结果判断与学习分类器提供反馈。

L4 事实：NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks 官方记录哈希为 02ee6b7295f720407b56c457b34c54d5；报告规模为 254,051 条指令；数据以 CC BY 4.0 开放；状态为 L4_carded，仅使用一个 Track 01 分类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
# Core idea

SciInstruct treats missing scientific rationales as an answer-constrained trace-inference problem: GPT-4 first proposes a worked solution, then critiques failures, finally receives the reference answer as a stronger hint, while a separate quality classifier removes plausible but defective traces. The serialized target is question plus worked solution and subject; source authors or GPT-4 supply traces, known answers and model-based filters decide retention, and ChatGLM3, Llama3, and Mistral SFT runs consume them, establishing a Track 01 data contribution.

Google Scholar citations: 16（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=SciInstruct%3A+a+Self-Reflective+Instruction+Annotated+Dataset+for+Training+Scientific+Language+Models&author=Dan+Zhang&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: SciInstruct Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zd21/SciInstruct Scale: reported full set of 254,051 instructions: 123,869 physics/chemistry, 89,934 math, and 40,248 Lean; three public files total about 139.3 MB Record form: content question, summary worked answer or proof, and subject label File / storage format: one JSON object per line in three .json files; the checked Chinese-math file has 9,110 records Domains / languages: physics, chemistry, college mathematics, and formal Lean proofs; Chinese and English Construction and filtering: collect answer-bearing questions, generate missing steps with GPT-4-0613, apply answer/outcome checks and up to two reflection retries, then rank noisy records with a ChatGLM3-feature quality classifier License / access constraints: public under CC BY 4.0 according to the NeurIPS datasheet and Hugging Face metadata; code has no separately declared license Intended use: scientific-rationale SFT, distillation, mixture/scaling analysis, and trace-quality audits

# 核心思想

SciInstruct 把缺失科学推理过程视为受答案约束的轨迹推断：GPT-4 先给出分步解答，再批判失败结果，最后以参考答案作更强提示；独立质量分类器继续剔除看似合理但有缺陷的轨迹。序列化目标是问题、分步解答与学科标签，源作者或 GPT-4 提供过程，已知答案和模型过滤器决定保留，ChatGLM3、Llama3 与 Mistral 的 SFT 负责消费，因此属于 Track 01 数据贡献。

Google Scholar 引用数：16（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=SciInstruct%3A+a+Self-Reflective+Instruction+Annotated+Dataset+for+Training+Scientific+Language+Models&author=Dan+Zhang&hl=en）

开放数据集：是 数据集名称：SciInstruct 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/zd21/SciInstruct 规模：完整集报告 254,051 条，其中物理/化学 123,869 条、数学 89,934 条、Lean 40,248 条；三个公开文件合计约 139.3 MB 记录形式：content 为问题，summary 为分步回答或证明，subject 为学科标签 文件/存储格式：三个扩展名为 .json 的逐行 JSON 文件；已核验中文数学文件含 9,110 条 领域/语言：物理、化学、大学数学与形式化 Lean 证明；中文和英文 构造与过滤：收集带答案问题，用 GPT-4-0613 补全步骤，经答案/结果核验和最多两次反思重试，再用基于 ChatGLM3 特征的质量分类器排序噪声记录 许可/访问约束：NeurIPS 数据说明和 Hugging Face 元数据均标明 CC BY 4.0；代码没有单独声明许可 预期用途：科学过程 SFT、蒸馏、混合/规模分析与轨迹质量审计

title: Method
方法
html:
# Method

  1. Assemble answer-bearing prompts. Input: textbook, pedagogical, public-QA, problem-set, and LeanDojo sources. Process: normalize physics, chemistry, mathematics, and theorem-proof items and translate selected Chinese questions into English when useful. Output: 257,143 raw questions or existing proof instructions. Check / stop rule: every record needs a question, answer/solution target, and subject; the paper does not release per-record source identifiers.
  2. Generate and reflect on missing rationales. Input: a question with its reference answer and GPT-4-0613. Process: sample a step-by-step solution, judge its outcome, then ask the same model to identify and repair errors; a third stage reveals the real answer if the second still fails. Output: answer-consistent worked traces. Check / stop rule: retain traces labeled correct; the illustrated 42,497-question subset yields 19,824 initially, 5,458 after first reflection, and 7,687 after answer-hinted reflection, totaling 32,969.
  3. Filter low-quality instructions. Input: accepted/source solutions plus model-generated candidate solutions. Process: combine source positives with ChatGLM2, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 negatives or judged samples, extract ChatGLM3-6B-Base features, and train a classifier with logits from -1 to 1. Output: ranked instructions and the final 254,051-record SciInstruct mixture. Check / stop rule: exclude the lowest-scoring 10% in the reported filtering ablation; correct final answers still do not certify all steps.
  4. Train and test consumers. Input: chatbot-formatted SciInstruct and ChatGLM3 6B/32B, Llama3-8B-Instruct, or Mistral-7B MetaMath. Process: run two-epoch SFT with Transformers and DeepSpeed, using learning rate 3e-6 for ChatGLM. Output: scientific, mathematical, general-language, mixture, scale, and pass@k results. Check / stop rule: task accuracy or code pass@1 determines outcomes, with leave-one-domain-out and data-fraction runs tracing data effects.

Reproducibility: verify the NeurIPS paper and datasheet, three CC BY 4.0 files, line-level content/summary/subject schema, prompts, reflection counts, classifier composition, and training scripts. A rebuild must freeze source snapshots, OCR, translations, GPT model revisions, sampling and judgment prompts, classifier cutoff, and benchmark splits; temperature, most rollout counts, random seeds, full token cost, and per-record provenance are not disclosed.

# 方法

  1. 汇集带答案的问题。输入来自教材、教学材料、公开问答、习题集和 LeanDojo。处理过程规范物理、化学、数学与定理证明条目，并在有利于求解时把部分中文题译成英文。输出是 257,143 个原始问题或已有证明指令。检查/停止规则要求每条都有问题、答案/解答目标和学科；论文没有公开逐条来源标识。
  2. 生成并反思缺失过程。输入是问题、参考答案和 GPT-4-0613。处理过程先采样分步解答并判断结果，再让同一模型定位并修复错误；若第二阶段仍失败，第三阶段把真实答案加入提示。输出是答案一致的分步轨迹。检查/停止规则只保留判断正确的结果；图示的 42,497 个问题依次获得 19,824、5,458 和 7,687 条正确解答，共 32,969 条。
  3. 过滤低质量指令。输入是已接受/源解答和模型生成候选。处理过程把源正例与 ChatGLM2、GPT-3.5、GPT-4 的负例或判断样本合并，抽取 ChatGLM3-6B-Base 特征，训练输出 -1 到 1 分数的分类器。输出是排序后的指令及最终 254,051 条 SciInstruct 混合。检查/停止规则在过滤消融中剔除最低十分之一；最终答案正确仍不能证明每一步正确。
  4. 训练并测试消费模型。输入是聊天格式的 SciInstruct，以及 ChatGLM3 6B/32B、Llama3-8B-Instruct 或 Mistral-7B MetaMath。处理过程使用 Transformers 与 DeepSpeed 做两轮 SFT，ChatGLM 学习率为 3e-6。输出涵盖科学、数学、通用语言、混合、规模和 pass@k 结果。检查/停止规则以任务准确率或代码 pass@1 判定，并用逐域删除与数据比例实验追踪数据作用。

复现要点：应核验 NeurIPS 论文与数据说明、三个 CC BY 4.0 文件、逐行 content/summary/subject 结构、提示、反思数量、分类器组成和训练脚本。复建还需固定源快照、OCR、翻译、GPT 版本、采样和判断提示、分类阈值及基准切分；论文没有披露温度、大多数采样次数、随机种子、完整 token 成本和逐条来源。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
# Evidence

Claim: the full rationale mixture improves a fixed scientific SFT consumer. Controlled setup: Table 4 compares ChatGLM3-6B-Base with the same base after SciInstruct SFT across CEval, MMLU, SciEval, SciBench, GPQA, and math tasks. Result: weighted average science rises from 38.12 to 41.40, mathematics from 42.56 to 49.24, and combined science-plus-math from 40.34 to 45.32. Filtering evidence: with the same 6B setup, removing the bottom 10% by quality score raises combined average from 46.03 to 46.54. Boundary: SFT changes the model behavior, but the paper does not compare equal-token mixtures against every source-only baseline, and the filter gain is small.

# 证据

主张：完整过程数据混合能改善固定的科学 SFT 消费模型。受控配置：表 4 对比 ChatGLM3-6B-Base 与同一基础模型经 SciInstruct 微调后在 CEval、MMLU、SciEval、SciBench、GPQA 和数学任务上的结果。结果：加权科学平均从 38.12 升到 41.40，数学从 42.56 升到 49.24，科学与数学综合从 40.34 升到 45.32。过滤证据：在同一 6B 配置下，剔除质量分最低十分之一使综合平均从 46.03 升到 46.54。边界：SFT 确实改变模型表现，但论文没有把所有源数据做等 token 单源对照，过滤收益也较小。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
# Novelty

Ordinary answer-filtered distillation discards questions when the first teacher trace fails. SciInstruct changes that curation decision by routing failures through critique, revision, and finally reference-answer hints before applying a separately trained instruction-quality filter. This exposes reflection stage and quality score as auditable selection points across science, mathematics, and formal proofs. Chain-of-thought prompting, final-answer checking, SFT, and Lean proof reuse are not individually new.

# 新意

普通答案过滤蒸馏会在首条教师轨迹失败后直接丢弃问题。SciInstruct 改变的策展决策，是让失败样本依次进入批判、修正和参考答案提示，再应用单独训练的指令质量过滤器。这样一来，反思阶段和质量分数成为跨科学、数学与形式证明的可审计筛选点。思维链提示、最终答案检查、SFT 和 Lean 证明复用本身都不是新方法。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
# Limitations

  • Author-stated boundary: final-answer consistency cannot detect every invalid intermediate step, and OCR can damage questions or source solutions; audit worked steps rather than trusting the outcome label.
  • Curator audit risk: GPT-4 generates, critiques, and judges many traces, while the learned classifier is trained on outputs from related models; stratify errors by source, teacher, language, and reflection stage.
  • Curator audit risk: records expose subject but not per-instance source or stage provenance; establish source/license keys, semantic deduplication, and train-test overlap evidence before redistribution or benchmark use.

# 局限

  • 作者明确的边界：最终答案一致无法发现所有错误中间步骤，OCR 也可能破坏问题或源解答；应审计推导过程，不能只信结果标签。
  • 策展审计风险：GPT-4 生成、批判并判断大量轨迹，学习分类器又使用相关模型输出训练；应按来源、教师、语言和反思阶段分层测量错误。
  • 策展审计风险：记录只有学科，没有逐条来源或阶段信息；再发布或用作基准前，应补来源/许可键、语义去重和训练测试重叠证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
# Usefulness

  • Scientific data builder: use reference-answer problems to implement generate, judge, reflect, answer-hint, and quality-rank stages; emit question/worked-solution/subject records with stage and source provenance added.
  • Dataset auditor: sample correctness by domain and reflection stage, compare final-answer validity with step validity, and measure how the quality cutoff changes source/language composition.
  • Do not use when: intermediate reasoning must be formally verified or per-record lineage is mandatory; the public schema and model-based checks do not meet those contracts without augmentation.

# 用处

  • 科学数据构建者：用带参考答案的问题实现生成、判断、反思、答案提示和质量排序阶段；输出问题、分步解答与学科记录，并补充阶段和来源信息。
  • 数据审计者：按领域和反思阶段抽查正确性，对比最终答案与步骤有效性，并测量质量阈值如何改变来源和语言组成。
  • 不适用情形：若中间推理必须形式核验，或逐条血缘是硬要求，则不能直接使用；公开结构与模型检查需要额外增强才能满足这些契约。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
# Reading notes

  • Positioning: SciInstruct fills missing scientific worked solutions; it is not a pretraining-corpus paper.
  • Method handle: generate, outcome-check, reflect, reveal the answer, then quality-rank is the decisive causal chain.
  • Data handle: the public record is content, summary, and subject; the paper reports 254,051 math, science, and Lean instructions.
  • Evidence anchor: the same ChatGLM3-6B base moves from 40.34 to 45.32 combined science-plus-math average after SFT.
  • Reuse decision: use only with per-record provenance, stage-stratified step audits, and explicit overlap checks added.

# 阅读笔记

  • 定位：SciInstruct 补全缺失的科学分步解答，不是预训练语料研究。
  • 方法抓手：生成、结果检查、反思、揭示答案、质量排序构成关键因果链。
  • 数据抓手：公开记录含 content、summary 和 subject；论文报告 254,051 条数学、科学和 Lean 指令。
  • 证据锚点：同一 ChatGLM3-6B 基础模型经 SFT 后，科学与数学综合平均从 40.34 升到 45.32。
  • 复用判断：只有补齐逐条来源、按阶段审计步骤并显式检查重叠后再使用。

value.html: Textbooks, pedagogical materials, public question-answer sites and problem sets for science and mathematics, plus LeanDojo theorem-proof records.
A scientific or formal-mathematics question in content, a worked solution or proof in summary, and a subject label.
Existing worked solutions are retained where available; GPT-4-0613 samples, critiques, and revises missing scientific reasoning traces, while Lean proofs come from their formal sources.
Static JSON Lines instruction records consumed as chatbot-style supervised fine-tuning data.

Known final answers and a GPT-4 outcome-labeling prompt filter candidate traces; a ChatGLM3-6B-Base feature classifier ranks instruction quality, while Lean source proofs provide formal targets rather than replayed compilation evidence.
Accept answer-consistent traces after up to three generation/reflection stages, then remove the lowest-scoring noisy instructions with the learned quality classifier.
ChatGLM3 6B/32B Base, Llama3-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B MetaMath are reported SFT consumers.
GPT-4-0613 generates, labels, critiques, and revises reasoning traces; GPT-3.5-turbo-0613 and ChatGLM2-6B contribute classifier negatives.
Initial chain-of-thought generation followed by a reflection prompt, then a reflection prompt that also reveals the reference answer.
The reflection subset begins with 42,497 questions and yields 32,969 accepted solutions across three stages; the final cross-domain mixture contains 254,051 instructions.
Keep traces judged answer-correct, retry failures through two reflection stages, then rank noisy instructions with a classifier trained from human/source positives and model-generated negatives.
Three possible GPT-4 generation/judgment stages per failed reflection question; total tokens, retries outside the illustrated subset, and API cost are not disclosed.
Standardize records as chat examples and fine-tune with Hugging Face Transformers and DeepSpeed for two epochs; ChatGLM experiments use learning rate 3e-6 and a linear scheduler.
The reported 254,051-record mixture contains 123,869 physics/chemistry, 89,934 mathematics, and 40,248 Lean proof instructions gathered from textbooks, public QA, problem sets, and LeanDojo.

The datasheet uses all records as training data. The author-maintained Hugging Face mirror exposes three JSON Lines files for Chinese math, English physics/chemistry, and Lean; the checked math file contains 9,110 directly readable records.
The authors state construction sources were not derived from evaluation test sets, but provide no item-level overlap report, semantic deduplication result, or public provenance key for every record.

items: A correct final answer can coexist with invalid intermediate steps, and GPT-4 is used in both trace generation and outcome judgment.
OCR damage, incomplete source problems, and a learned quality classifier can introduce source- and model-specific selection bias.
Public records do not carry per-instance source URLs or reflection-stage provenance, limiting license and lineage audits below the dataset level.
